title: Social Science Information Sources and Service: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
unitTitle: Social Science Information Sources and Service
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Explain FIVE qualities of a good social science librarian.
Describe anthropology as a branch of social science.
Using relevant examples discuss various information centers where social scientist can search and retrieve information.

items.text: Section B ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS (EACH CARRY 20 MARKS)
Elimu Social Science Library wants to hire a librarian. Describe some of the qualifications you will advise them to consider when hiring.

parts.text: Describe any FIVE social science reference sources.
Internet is a useful information source for social scientists. Briefly discuss.
Briefly analyze various uses of encyclopedias in the area of social sciences.
Explain what makes a good bibliography in social sciences.

items.text: Current awareness is a service that keeps end-users updated on new information and developments in their fields of interest. Discuss various techniques a library can use to provide current awareness services.
